title: 5 BEST AI Stocks for the Next 5 Years
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Mark Roussin names his five best AI stocks for the next five years, deliberately excluding Nvidia, which he owns as a top-ten holding but did not pick today, and stresses that a great AI company is not a great investment at any price. He owns all five and says he will build bigger positions in all of them. AMD is a CONDITIONAL_BUY, reiterated: a favourite for five-plus years and a credible second source to Nvidia via Helios and server CPUs, with $1,000 a share expected in 2027, but not cheap after rising about 180% in twelve months, so he adds only on pullbacks. Broadcom is a BUY at about $370, reiterated, his strongest conviction: custom accelerators, networking and software, roughly flat for a year while earnings are expected to rise about 70% twice, with model fair value near $470. Marvell is a CONDITIONAL_BUY at about $280, a soft flip from BUY in February: he sees $400 over two years on custom silicon, but counsels patience after a 200% run. Amazon is a BUY at about $260, reiterated, to nibble now and buy aggressively on pullbacks, on AWS scale and Trainium. Credo is a BUY, upgraded from conditional in October, his highest-risk and biggest-upside pick, expected above $300 in 2027 on the AI connectivity bottleneck. Based on the captions analysis recorded in the 19:00 run on 2026-10-13; auto-captions garble some figures.

calls.base_case: Models value ~$230, analyst PT $280 for the next 12 months; stock has swung $86-$309, so position sizing matters.
calls.bull_case: If AI infrastructure keeps expanding, thousands of accelerators must move data quickly and reliably regardless of which GPU vendor wins — Credo is positioned in that layer.
